boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten documented public destinations on corridors in the California Lutheran University orbit, each with one concrete reason to go.

cards.title: Gardens of the World — five garden styles
cards.subtitle: Thousand Oaks Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk the paths through the English, French, Italian, Japanese, and California Mission garden areas; check the garden’s posted closure notices before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A 4.5-acre cultural garden with five distinct landscape areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Gardens of the World at 2001 Thousand Oaks Boulevard has five gardens and walking paths with plants, flowers, and water features.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; last admittance is 4:30 p.m. Closed Sunday and Monday, most national holidays, and during inclement weather.

cards.entity_name: Bank of America Performing Arts Center at the Thousand Oaks Civic Arts Plaza
cards.title: Civic Arts Plaza — a performance calendar
cards.subtitle: Thousand Oaks Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Look up the current program before traveling, then choose a ticketed performance or arts event that fits your schedule and budget.
cards.short_summary: A Thousand Oaks Boulevard performing-arts venue supported by TOArts.
cards.evidence_claim: TOArts presents and supports visual and performing arts at the Bank of America Performing Arts Center, located at 2100 Thousand Oaks Boulevard.
cards.source_title: TOArts — Arts Council of the Conejo Valley
cards.access_notes: Event access, start times, and ticket requirements vary by program; consult the presenter’s current listing.

cards.title: Hillcrest Center — gallery and classes
cards.subtitle: Hillcrest Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition or class listing, then plan a daytime visit to see the arts facilities and public gallery programming.
cards.short_summary: A city-owned arts center with theater, visual arts, and class activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillcrest Center for the Arts at 403 West Hillcrest Drive provides community theater, performing and fine arts classes, and music and dance performances.
cards.source_title: Hillcrest Center for the Arts — Arts Council of the Conejo Valley
cards.access_notes: Program, gallery, and performance access varies; confirm the applicable listing or box office information before visiting.

cards.title: Conejo Creek North Park — ponds and paths
cards.subtitle: East Janss Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the 0.67-mile walking path to loop past the two ponds and stream, then pause at the designated Healing Garden with appropriate respect.
cards.short_summary: A creekside park with ponds, paths, picnic areas, and a Healing Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Conejo Creek North Park at 1379 East Janss Road has two ponds connected by a recirculating stream, a 0.67-mile walking path, and the Healing Garden.
cards.source_title: Conejo Creek North Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Park hours vary seasonally: 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. November–February, 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. March and October, and 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. April–September.

cards.title: Conejo Creek South Park — field-side walk
cards.subtitle: East Janss Road corridor
cards.notes: Take the 0.65-mile recreational walking path around the sports grounds; give permitted teams space and check field conditions before a visit.
cards.short_summary: A 55-acre park with a recreational path, baseball field, and soccer fields.
cards.evidence_claim: Conejo Creek South Park at 1300 East Janss Road includes a 0.65-mile recreational walking path, one baseball field, and 12 soccer fields.
cards.source_title: Conejo Creek South Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; athletic games must finish and field lights be off by 8:30 p.m.

cards.title: Thousand Oaks Community Park — disc golf
cards.subtitle: North Moorpark Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring a disc for the Rabbit Flats Disc Golf Course, which is first-come, first-served; use the posted park rules and share paths courteously.
cards.short_summary: A 35.8-acre community park with a first-come disc golf course.
cards.evidence_claim: Thousand Oaks Community Park at 2525 North Moorpark Road is home to Rabbit Flats Disc Golf Course, available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Thousand Oaks Community Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Park open daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; outdoor courts and the disc golf course are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Conejo Community Park — lawn amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Hendrix Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a blanket for a listed Summer Concerts in the Park date, or use the park’s picnic areas and ballfield during regular park access.
cards.short_summary: An oak-filled community park with a sloped lawn amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Conejo Community Park at 1175 Hendrix Avenue has picnic areas, a ballfield, and a sloped-lawn amphitheater that hosts Summer Concerts in the Park.
cards.source_title: Conejo Community Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Concert dates and any event-specific conditions vary; confirm the district’s current event information before visiting.

cards.title: Borchard Community Park — skatepark
cards.subtitle: Reino Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the districtwide skatepark during open park hours and follow posted rules; the site also has courts, fields, picnic areas, and community rooms.
cards.short_summary: A 29-acre community park whose amenities include a districtwide skatepark.
cards.evidence_claim: Borchard Community Park at 190 Reino Road includes a districtwide skatepark as well as courts, fields, picnic areas, and community rooms.
cards.source_title: Borchard Community Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Park open daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; check the district’s open-gym and skatepark information for program-specific access.

cards.title: Dos Vientos Community Park — courts and fields
cards.subtitle: Borchard Road corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime walk around the community park, then use its picnic areas, courts, or fields only as their availability and reservation status allow.
cards.short_summary: A 28-acre community park with fields, courts, rooms, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Dos Vientos Community Park at 4801 Borchard Road has reservable picnic areas and rooms, fields, and sports courts for day and evening use.
cards.source_title: Dos Vientos Community Park — Conejo Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; reservations may be required for specific facilities.

cards.entity_name: Satwiwa Native American Indian Culture Center
cards.title: Satwiwa Culture Center — exhibits and programs
cards.subtitle: Lynn Road corridor
cards.notes: Visit on a weekend for the cultural exhibits and seasonal Native American programs; review the National Park Service’s current hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A National Park Service cultural center at the Lynn Road and Via Goleta entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Satwiwa Native American Indian Culture Center, at the Lynn Road and Via Goleta entrance in Newbury Park, offers cultural exhibits and seasonal Native American programs.
cards.source_title: Operating Hours & Seasons — Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday and Sunday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; closed Monday–Friday and on most federal holidays.
